metadata.title: Quad-Circular Portrait Collage with Ornate Filigree

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring four circular photographic vignettes arranged in a diamond pattern, set against a stark white field. The circles are connected by delicate, embossed-style white filigree patterns. The top of the design features bold, stylized black serif typography with a secondary arced line of text below it.
coreVisualRelationships: Four circular portraits forming a central diamond cluster
High-contrast black typography against a vast white negative space
Subtle white-on-white decorative scrollwork framing the circular cutouts
Warm-toned, lush green background photography within each circle
coreInvariants: Circular masking for all subject photography
Symmetrical diamond arrangement of the four circles
Black display type at the top center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four equal-sized circular portraits occupy the center of the frame in a 1-2-1 vertical diamond stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top circular portrait featuring a figure in a vibrant red garment acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold black header, move down through the arced text, and then circulate through the four portraits in a clockwise or diamond pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central cluster, pushing all visual weight to the center and top.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background providing a clean, minimalist canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for primary typography and dark photographic shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red, forest green, and earthy browns within the photographic circles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the circular windows contrasted against a zero-saturation white environment.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight contrast between thick and thin strokes
Tightly kerned characters with some overlapping elements
Curvilinear baseline for the secondary text line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a stylized, open descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same decorative serif family, using path warping for hierarchy.

preserve: Arched baseline for the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s decorative serif feel with flared terminals.
Provides the high contrast and sharp serifs seen in the display type.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a pure white background. In the center, arrange four circular windows in a diamond pattern (one top, two middle, one bottom). Inside each circle, place a portrait of a person in 1970s attire against a lush green garden background. Add subtle, white-on-white embossed floral filigree connecting the circles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a bold, high-contrast black decorative serif at the top center. Below it, add a subtitle in the same font style, but smaller and arced in a convex curve over the top portrait circle.

verificationChecks: Are the four circles perfectly aligned in a diamond?
Is the background pure white without texture?
Is the subtitle text properly arced?
Does the filigree remain subtle and low-contrast (white-on-white)?

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance of the diamond cluster.
Ensure the white-on-white filigree is visible but not distracting.
Verify the typography has the characteristic 70s 'swash' or flared serif look.
Confirm the photography within circles has a consistent warm, vintage color grade.
recipe.reuseFormula: Diamond-pattern circular collage + White-on-white filigree + Arched decorative serif header.
